14
Adwammaa no ne ne nkurɔfoɔ
1 # Adi 7.4; 3.12 Na mehunui, na hwɛ, Adwammaa no gyina Sion bepɔ so, na mpem ɔha aduanan nnan a wɔatwerɛtwerɛ ne din ne n’Agya din wɔ wɔn moma soɔ no ka ne ho. 2#Adi 1.15 Na metee nne bi firi soro te sɛ nsuo bebree nne, ne aprannaa kɛseɛ nne. Na ɛnne a meteeɛ no te sɛ sankubɔfoɔ a wɔrebɔ wɔn asankuo. 3#Adi 5.9 Na wɔtoo dwom foforɔ bi, ahennwa ne ateasefoɔ baanan ne mpanimfoɔ no anim, na obiara antumi ansua dwom no, gye mpem ɔha aduanan nnan a wɔagye wɔn afiri asase soɔ no nko.
4 # 2 Ko 11.2; Efe 5.27; Adi 5.9 Yeinom ne wɔn a wɔamfa mmaa angu wɔn ho fi, na wɔyɛ mmabunu, wɔn na wɔdi Adwammaa no akyire baabiara a ɔkorɔ. Yeinom na wɔagye wɔn nkwa afiri nnipa mu ayɛ wɔn aba a ɔdi kan ama Onyankopɔn ne Adwammaa no, 5na wɔanhunu atorɔ bi wɔ wɔn anomu; na wɔnni dɛm.
Abɔfoɔ baasa no
6 # Adi 8.13 Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ a ɔtu nam soro mfimfini a ɔkura daa asɛmpa bi rekɔka akyerɛ wɔn a wɔte asase soɔ, ne aman ne mmusuakuo ne kasa ne nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa, 7na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛ: Monsuro Onyankopɔn na monhyɛ no animuonyam, ɛfiri sɛ n’atemmuo dɔn adu. Na monkoto deɛ ɔyɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase ne ɛpo ne asutire no.
8 # Adi 18.2; Yes 21.9; Yer 51.7-8 Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu dii akyire kaa sɛ: Babel kɛseɛ no ahwe ase, ahwe ase, ɛfiri sɛ wama amanaman nyinaa anom n’adwamammɔ abufuo nsa no bi.
9 # Adi 13.12-17 Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa dii wɔn akyiri de nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛ: Sɛ obi koto aboa no ne ne honi no, na ɔgye agyiraeɛ de si ne moma anaa ne nsa so a, 10#Adi 16.19; Yer 25.15; Adi 19.20 ɔno ara na ɔbɛnom Nyankopɔn abufuo nsa a wɔahwie no gyenegyene agu n’abufuo kuruwa mu no bie, na wɔayɛ no ayayadeɛ, ogya ne sɔfe mu, abɔfoɔ kronkron ne Adwammaa no anim. 11#Adi 19.3 Na wɔn ayayadeɛ wisie bɛforo soro daa daa, na wɔn a wɔbɛkoto aboa no ne ne honi, ne obiara a ɔbɛgye ne din agyiraeɛ no, rennya ɔhome awia ne anadwo. 12#Adi 13.10; 12.17 Ɛha na ahotefoɔ boasetɔ wɔ, wɔn a wɔkura Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ ne Yesu gyidie mu no.
Asase so Twaberɛ
13 # Yes 57.2; Heb 4.10 Na metee ɛnne bi firii soro a ɛkaa sɛ: Twerɛ sɛ: Nhyira ne awufoɔ a wɔwu Awurade mu firi seesei rekorɔ yi. Honhom no se: Aane, wɔbɛhome afiri wɔn brɛ no mu; na wɔn nnwuma di wɔn akyi.
14 # Dan 7.13; Mat 13.39; 13.41 Na mehunui, na hwɛ, omununkum fitaa, na obi a ɔte sɛ onipa ba te mununkum no so, na ɔbɔ sika abotire na ɔkura kantankrankyi nnamnnam bi. 15#Yoel 3.13 Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ firi asɔredan no mu de nne kɛseɛ teaa mu kyerɛɛ deɛ ɔte mununkum no soɔ no sɛ: To wo kantankrankyi twitwa, ɛfiri sɛ twaberɛ adu, na asase so nnoɔma ahoa. 16Na deɛ ɔte mununkum no soɔ no de ne kantankrankyi too asase so, na ɔtwitwaa asase so nnoɔma nyinaa.
17Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ firi soro asɔredan no mu, na ɔno nso kura kantankrankyi nnamnnam. 18#Adi 14.15 Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ a ɔwɔ ogya so tumi firii afɔrebukyia mu de nne kɛseɛ teaa mu kyerɛɛ deɛ ɔkura kantankrankyi nnamnnam no sɛ: To wo kantankrankyi nnamnnam no twitwa asase so bobe asiasia, ɛfiri sɛ n’aba no abere. 19#Adi 19.15 Na ɔbɔfoɔ no de ne kantankrankyi no too asase so, na ɔtwitwaa asase so bobe aba, na ɔde kɔguu Nyankopɔn abufuo nsa-kyi-amena kɛseɛ no mu. 20#Yes 63.3 Na wɔtiatiaa nsa-kyi-amena no so kuro no akyi, na mogya firii nsa-kyi-amena no mu kɔduruu apɔnkɔ nnareka ho, tenee nkwansimma apem ahansia.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na mehunui, na hwɛ, Adwammaa no gyina Sion bepɔ so, na mpem ɔha aduanan nnan a wɔatwerɛtwerɛ ne din ne n’Agya din wɔ wɔn moma soɔ no ka ne ho. Na metee nne bi firi soro te sɛ nsuo bebree nne, ne aprannaa kɛseɛ nne. Na ɛnne a meteeɛ no te sɛ sankubɔfoɔ a wɔrebɔ wɔn asankuo. Na wɔtoo dwom foforɔ bi, ahennwa ne ateasefoɔ baanan ne mpanimfoɔ no anim, na obiara antumi ansua dwom no, gye mpem ɔha aduanan nnan a wɔagye wɔn afiri asase soɔ no nko.
Yeinom ne wɔn a wɔamfa mmaa angu wɔn ho fi, na wɔyɛ mmabunu, wɔn na wɔdi Adwammaa no akyire baabiara a ɔkorɔ. Yeinom na wɔagye wɔn nkwa afiri nnipa mu ayɛ wɔn aba a ɔdi kan ama Onyankopɔn ne Adwammaa no, na wɔanhunu atorɔ bi wɔ wɔn anomu; na wɔnni dɛm.

Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ a ɔtu nam soro mfimfini a ɔkura daa asɛmpa bi rekɔka akyerɛ wɔn a wɔte asase soɔ, ne aman ne mmusuakuo ne kasa ne nkurɔfoɔ nyinaa, na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛ: Monsuro Onyankopɔn na monhyɛ no animuonyam, ɛfiri sɛ n’atemmuo dɔn adu. Na monkoto deɛ ɔyɛɛ ɔsoro ne asase ne ɛpo ne asutire no.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu dii akyire kaa sɛ: Babel kɛseɛ no ahwe ase, ahwe ase, ɛfiri sɛ wama amanaman nyinaa anom n’adwamammɔ abufuo nsa no bi.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa dii wɔn akyiri de nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛ: Sɛ obi koto aboa no ne ne honi no, na ɔgye agyiraeɛ de si ne moma anaa ne nsa so a, ɔno ara na ɔbɛnom Nyankopɔn abufuo nsa a wɔahwie no gyenegyene agu n’abufuo kuruwa mu no bie, na wɔayɛ no ayayadeɛ, ogya ne sɔfe mu, abɔfoɔ kronkron ne Adwammaa no anim. Na wɔn ayayadeɛ wisie bɛforo soro daa daa, na wɔn a wɔbɛkoto aboa no ne ne honi, ne obiara a ɔbɛgye ne din agyiraeɛ no, rennya ɔhome awia ne anadwo. Ɛha na ahotefoɔ boasetɔ wɔ, wɔn a wɔkura Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ ne Yesu gyidie mu no.

Na metee ɛnne bi firii soro a ɛkaa sɛ: Twerɛ sɛ: Nhyira ne awufoɔ a wɔwu Awurade mu firi seesei rekorɔ yi. Honhom no se: Aane, wɔbɛhome afiri wɔn brɛ no mu; na wɔn nnwuma di wɔn akyi.
Na mehunui, na hwɛ, omununkum fitaa, na obi a ɔte sɛ onipa ba te mununkum no so, na ɔbɔ sika abotire na ɔkura kantankrankyi nnamnnam bi. Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ firi asɔredan no mu de nne kɛseɛ teaa mu kyerɛɛ deɛ ɔte mununkum no soɔ no sɛ: To wo kantankrankyi twitwa, ɛfiri sɛ twaberɛ adu, na asase so nnoɔma ahoa. Na deɛ ɔte mununkum no soɔ no de ne kantankrankyi too asase so, na ɔtwitwaa asase so nnoɔma nyinaa.
Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ firi soro asɔredan no mu, na ɔno nso kura kantankrankyi nnamnnam. Na ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ a ɔwɔ ogya so tumi firii afɔrebukyia mu de nne kɛseɛ teaa mu kyerɛɛ deɛ ɔkura kantankrankyi nnamnnam no sɛ: To wo kantankrankyi nnamnnam no twitwa asase so bobe asiasia, ɛfiri sɛ n’aba no abere. Na ɔbɔfoɔ no de ne kantankrankyi no too asase so, na ɔtwitwaa asase so bobe aba, na ɔde kɔguu Nyankopɔn abufuo nsa-kyi-amena kɛseɛ no mu. Na wɔtiatiaa nsa-kyi-amena no so kuro no akyi, na mogya firii nsa-kyi-amena no mu kɔduruu apɔnkɔ nnareka ho, tenee nkwansimma apem ahansia.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
